speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To better understand the progression of your condition, have you noticed any specific trigger for your rash, such as exposure to certain chemicals or plants? Additionally, do you experience any fatigue or joint pain alongside the numbness and tingling?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any scale or discoloration on your palms, and do you have a history of working with pesticides or handling specific plants like poison ivy? Also, have you checked your blood sugar levels recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)

I am puzzled by your previous physician's suggestion of pneumonia, as your symptoms of hypopigmented skin lesions, loss of eyelashes, and peripheral neuropathy are classic for leprosy. Have you noticed any muscle weakness in your hands or feet, or any thickening of your skin folds?
